title: Standardized Red-Team Protocol for AI Agent Monitoring: A Methodological Proposal and Pilot

original_idea.body:
# Standardized Red-Team Protocol for AI Agent Monitoring: A Methodological Proposal and Pilot

**Problem:** METR's red-team of Anthropic monitoring was ad hoc — no standard methodology exists for red-teaming AI monitoring systems, making results incomparable across organizations.

**Direction:** Draft a standardized red-team protocol for AI monitoring systems (attack categories, success metrics, scope definitions). Pilot the protocol against a simple open-source monitoring setup. Publish the protocol as a proposed standard.

**Why it matters:** Without a standard methodology, monitoring red-teams produce incommensurable results. A shared protocol would accelerate the field and allow organizations to benchmark against each other.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 red-teaming; absence of standard monitoring red-team methodology (identified as open problem).
